purpose: Teach: 戦隊/唐辛子/車いす/垣根/熱海/ウェディング/アロハ/ミント

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが戦隊ヒーローのおもちゃ買ってきて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad brought home a sentai hero toy for you.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle pace. Sharing a small delight with him. The tone of a mother noting something she thinks will make him happy. Slight lift at the end—an invitation to his joy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、唐辛子無しで食べたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat it without the chili.
lines.style: Practical and direct, like he's answering a question nobody asked. Calm. A small child's logic that makes perfect sense to him. No complaint in it, just statement.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが車いすでもお元気に散歩してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandfather is still taking walks even with his wheelchair. He's doing so well.
lines.style: Pride and affection layered underneath. Measured tempo. A small marvel in her voice—she's noticed something good and wants Sho to notice it too. Soft and steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがお家の垣根を直してくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa fixed the hedge at our house for us.
lines.style: Bright announcement. Quick tempo, eager to share. Pride in his small chest—he noticed something Grandpa did. Genuine delight, not performing. Slightly breathless with the news.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと熱海の温泉に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you and Dad go to the hot springs in Atami together?
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, like she's offering him something. Warm and tender. Not commanding—inviting. Slight warmth on his name. The cadence of a mother thinking of his happiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、いつかメイ姉さんのウェディング、見たいよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to see Mei's wedding someday.
lines.style: Soft wish. Quieter than before—a genuine want, not a demand. Like he's sharing a secret hope. Dreamy quality. Trailing off slightly at the end, like he's imagining it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアロハシャツでお出かけなさったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went out in an aloha shirt.
lines.style: Amused observation, barely contained smile in the voice. Dry warmth. The fondness of noticing something slightly silly that someone you love did. Light, gentle exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ミント味のチョコ食べたい
lines.en: Mom, I want to eat some mint chocolate.
lines.style: Direct request, simple and clear. No edge to it—just a small want from a six-year-old. Warm and close, like he trusts her to say yes. Easy tempo.
